description: E2E governance contract key definition (issue #2491): the single bucketing identity for flaky/p95 statistics and observation windows

key_fields.node: major of the frontend build Node
key_fields.playwright: major of the locked playwright package
key_fields.pytest: major of the locked pytest package
key_fields.pytest_rerunfailures: major of the locked pytest-rerunfailures package
key_fields.pytest_timeout: major of the locked pytest-timeout package

excluded_from_key.runner_patch_version: GitHub hosted image patch versions are recorded only, never compared
excluded_from_key.timestamps: run timestamps never participate in identity

reset_triggers: key capability change (browser engine major, remote provider)
rules.reset_procedure: only an reviewed PR may reset an observation window; CI never auto-extends
rules.promotion_requires: flaky=0 and p95<=15m over >=20 effective runs under the CURRENT contract key
